{"credits": [{"type": "analyst", "user": {"avatar_url": "https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/114586487?v=4", "events_url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95/events{/privacy}", "followers_url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95/followers", "following_url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95/following{/other_user}", "gists_url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95/gists{/gist_id}", "gravatar_id": "", "html_url": "https://github.com/noren95", "id": 114586487, "login": "noren95", "node_id": "U_kgDOBtRzdw", "organizations_url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95/orgs", "received_events_url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95/received_events", "repos_url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95/repos", "site_admin": false, "starred_url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95/starred{/owner}{/repo}", "subscriptions_url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95/subscriptions", "type": "User", "url": "https://api.github.com/users/noren95", "user_view_type": "public"}}], "cve_id": "CVE-2025-29923", "cvss": {"score": 3.7, "vector_string": "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N"}, "cvss_severities": {"cvss_v3": {"score": 3.7, "vector_string": "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N"}, "cvss_v4": {"score": 0.0, "vector_string": null}}, "cwes": [{"cwe_id": "CWE-20", "name": "Improper Input Validation"}], "description": "### Impact

The issue only occurs when the `CLIENT SETINFO` command times out during connection establishment. The following circumstances can cause such a timeout:

1. The client is configured to transmit its identity. This can be disabled via the `DisableIndentity` flag.
2. There are network connectivity issues
3. The client was configured with aggressive timeouts

The impact differs by use case:

* **Sticky connections**: Rather than using a connection from the pool on-demand, the caller can stick with a connection. Then you receive persistent out-of-order responses for the lifetime of the connection.
* **Pipelines**: All commands in the pipeline receive incorrect responses.
* **Default connection pool usage without pipelining**: When used with the default [ConnPool](https://github.com/redis/go-redis/blob/8fadbef84a3f4e7573f8b38e5023fd469470a8a4/internal/pool/pool.go#L77) once a connection is returned after use with [ConnPool#Put](https://github.com/redis/go-redis/blob/8fadbef84a3f4e7573f8b38e5023fd469470a8a4/internal/pool/pool.go#L366) the read buffer will be checked and the connection will be marked as bad due to the unread data. This means that at most one out-of-order response before the connection is discarded.

### Patches
We prepared a fix in https://github.com/redis/go-redis/pull/3295 and plan to release patch versions soon. Versions 9.7.2, 9.6.3, and 9.5.5 were patched. However, 9.7.2 has been yanked, making 9.7.3 the lowest available 9.7.x version with a patch.

### Workarounds
You can prevent the vulnerability by setting the flag `DisableIndentity` (BTW: We also need to fix the spelling.) to `true` when constructing the client instance.
